**Green. 625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Only 3 cases were red, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount amount. It applied tax to `cents`, not to the discounted sum. Most rows had a zero discount or zero tax, so they hid it.

Fixed in [pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). Now it taxes the discounted amount.

No next step.
